Foliation jumps from 90 to 101, as indicated on f.90; foliation jumps from 200 to 181' as indicated on f.200; foliation jumps from 242 to 245 but text is complete; foliation jumps from 309 to 331 as indicated on f.309. The colophon in Derge provides details on translators.
